content: DMN decision service REST: KIE/Kogito auto-generates POST .../dmn/models/{model} (business-domain simplified output), POST .../dmn/models/{model}/{decisionService} (specific DS, bare value for single-output DS), POST .../dmn/models/{model}/dmnresult (full DMNResult: dmnContext, messages Info/Warn/Error, decisionResults[] with decisionId/name/result/evaluationStatus). No native batch endpoint — each call evaluates one model instance. Fired-rules-level trace not in standard response; explainability via separate TrustyAI tooling. Singleton coercion returns bare value for single-output decision services. OpenAPI auto-generated at /dmn/openapi.json.
